verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented capability to export all account or project data in open formats for leaving the platform. Archiving lets you record, save, and retrieve sessions, but that is a session-recording feature with no stated formats or full-export scope, so it is adjacent rather than a data-portability capability. The migration guides cover moving onto Vonage from TokBox or Twilio, not moving off it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
